title: Fundamentals of Agricultural and Environmental Chemistry
description:
Prerequisite: Minimum grade of C- in CHEM131 and CHEM132; and minimum grade of C- in (PLSC110 and PLSC11) or (PLSC112 and PLSC113) or (BSCI160 and BSCI180 or BSCI161) or (BSCI170 and BSCI180 or BSCI171).
Restriction: Must not have completed CHEM104 or CHEM105; and must be in a major within the AGNR-College of Agriculture and Natural Resources; or permission of instructor.
Credit only granted for: AGST275 or PLSC275.
Formerly: PLSC275.
